prompt: Claude replied with `stop_reason: "tool_use"` and two `tool_use` blocks. You run both and also want to add a short text note. How must the next user message be structured?

options.text: The text first, then the two `tool_result` blocks.
Only one `tool_result` per user message, sent in two separate requests.
The `tool_result` blocks first in the content array, and any text after all of them.
